item.title: Ueno Zoo — Guide
item.description: Ueno Zoo (Ueno Zoological Gardens), opened in 1882 within Ueno Park, is Japan’s oldest zoo and one of its most popular, especially beloved by families. Its most famous residents by far are the giant pandas, which draw huge crowds and have long been the zoo’s star attraction and a symbol of Ueno itself. Beyond the pandas, the zoo is home to a wide variety of animals across its East and West gardens — from elephants, tigers, gorillas and polar bears to a children’s petting area — connected by a short monorail (one of Japan’s first).
